Name: Swamp Siren
Author: PumpkintheGoblin
Description:
A tiny Fashion Sense pack inspired by the Frogsong Tavern & Apothecary for your farmer. Become a little green swamp creature 💚

𝕴𝖓𝖘𝖙𝖆𝖑𝖑𝖆𝖙𝖎𝖔𝖓:🐸🌿[list]
[*][size=3] Download and extract the mod files.[/size]
[*][size=3] Move the extracted files to your Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3] Launch the game.[/size]
[/list]𝕴𝖓𝖘𝖙𝖗𝖚𝖈𝖙𝖎𝖔𝖓𝖘: 🐸🌿
Use the Hand Mirror purchased from Pierre's to customize your farmer's look. Tail and Ears can be found in the accessories tab, and the arm fins are in sleeves.
